files.description: Bike-share trips, 1 September to 1 November 2025 (1500 rows): trip_id (whole number), rider_id (refers to riders.csv), start_station and end_station (refer to station_code in stations.csv), started_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), duration_min (whole minutes; about 3% empty), distance_km (two decimals), fare (two decimals; about 3% empty), payment (card, app or cash; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), rating (1-5 stars, whole number; about 19% empty).

task_text: Summarise the trips by payment method (trim spaces and use lower case): the number of trips, the total fare, the mean distance_km and the share of trips that have a rating, all rounded to 2 decimals. `result` should be a table indexed by payment method with the columns n_trips, total_fare, mean_km and rated_share.
intended_computation: Read trips.csv, normalise payment (strip, lower case) and per payment method give: n_trips (row count), total_fare (sum of non-empty fares), mean_km (mean distance_km) and rated_share (share of trips with a non-empty rating), each rounded to 2 decimals; indexed by payment method.
notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
